notes: The source URL is the Architectural Design A.S. page, not the Architectural Science Certificate of Achievement. The extracted text contains only site navigation, the A.S. Plan of Study Grid (Total Units/Hours 59-61, including VC GE areas) and an outcomes tab; the program requirements tab for any award is not in the text.

No requirements for the Architectural Science certificate are printed, so no blocks, totals or degree figures are recorded. The 59-61 total belongs to the A.S. plan of study and is not this certificate's total.
The plan of study refers to 'Required Additional Courses' (2-3 units each) and 'Elective ARCH course' slots without listing them; those lists were not captured.

The outcomes tab on the page lists four program student learning outcomes for the A.S. (Architectural Design) program; they were not recorded because the page is for a different award and it is not stated that the certificate shares them. A reviewer should check the certificate's own page.
The reviewer should locate the Architectural Science Certificate of Achievement page in the 2026-2027 Ventura College catalog.
